about: Tillsonburg is a town in Oxford County, Ontario, in southwestern Ontario’s tobacco-belt and manufacturing countryside between London and Lake Erie. A compact downtown, industrial parks, and surrounding farms define a classic county service centre. Highways 3 and 19 meet near the town. About 19,000 people live in Tillsonburg.
